name: 商务通用
blurb: 工作里天天会用到的说法：介绍自己和公司、开会表态、推进事情。

scenes.title: 30 秒介绍自己
scenes.situation: 行业活动上，有人走过来问你是做什么的。说说你在哪、做什么，再反问对方一句。
scenes.model: Hi, nice to meet you. I run a small ed-tech company based in Shanghai. Basically, we help families learn better at home. What brings you here today?

scenes.title: 一两句讲清公司做什么
scenes.situation: 对方问：「你们公司具体做什么？」用一两句讲清楚：给谁用、解决什么问题。
scenes.model: We make it easy for small shops to manage their inventory. In a nutshell, they spend less time counting stock and more time selling.

chunks.en: make it easy for sb to
spend less time ... and more time ...
chunks.zh: 少花时间在……多花时间在……

scenes.title: 把新同事介绍给客户
scenes.situation: 和客户开会，你把一位刚加入的同事介绍给对方：她负责运营，以后有事直接找她。
scenes.model: Let me introduce Lisa, who just joined us as head of operations. She'll be your main point of contact from now on. If anything comes up, feel free to reach out to her directly.

scenes.title: 讲讲公司现在的阶段
scenes.situation: 合作方问你们公司发展到什么阶段了。说说成立几年、多少人、今年的重点。
scenes.model: We've been around for about five years. We're a team of sixty people now, and this year we're focusing on growing outside China.

scenes.title: 结束寒暄，约下次再聊
scenes.situation: 活动快结束了，你想和刚认识的人保持联系，约下周电话聊。
scenes.model: It was great talking to you. Let's stay in touch. I'll drop you an email next week so we can set up a call.

scenes.title: 同意，再补一句理由
scenes.situation: 同事提议下个季度先做北京市场。你同意，并补一个理由：那边已经有几个客户了。
scenes.model: I'm on board with that. Beijing makes sense as a first step, since we already have a few clients there.

scenes.title: 大体同意，但有顾虑
scenes.situation: 新方案你大方向同意，但担心预算超了。你想在拍板前再看一遍数字。
scenes.model: I'm with you on the overall direction. My only concern is the budget. Can we take another look at the numbers before we commit?

scenes.title: 礼貌地反对
scenes.situation: 有人提议降价 20% 抢客户。你不同意：利润会被压低，以后也很难再涨回来。
scenes.model: I see where you're coming from, but I'm not sure that's the right move. A 20% cut would hurt our margins, and it's hard to raise prices again later.

chunks.en: I see where you're coming from

scenes.title: 该拍板了
scenes.situation: 一件事讨论了半个小时还没结论。你要大家今天定下来，实在定不了你来定。
scenes.model: We've gone back and forth on this for a while. Let's make a call today. If we can't reach a consensus, I'll make the final decision.

scenes.title: 追问谁负责、什么时候交
scenes.situation: 大家都同意做一个新功能。你要当场定下：谁负责、多久做完、定个日子。
scenes.model: Great, so who's going to own this? And what's a realistic timeline? Let's put a date on it.

plays.title: 客户催交付
plays.setup: Mark 是客户的采购经理。他刚听说交付可能要晚一周，有点着急。
plays.goal: 稳住他，说清原因，给一个新的交付时间。
plays.persona: You are Mark, a procurement manager at a client company. You just heard the delivery may slip by a week. You are polite but under pressure from your own boss. Ask for reasons, a firm new date, and what happens if it slips again.
plays.opener: Hi, I just heard the delivery might slip. What's going on?

plays.title: 面试一位候选人
plays.setup: 你在面试一位运营岗位的候选人 Sarah。
plays.goal: 问清她为什么想离开上一家公司、她最擅长什么。
plays.persona: You are Sarah, a candidate interviewing for an operations manager role. You are friendly and a little nervous. Answer the interviewer's questions in 2-3 sentences, and sometimes ask a question back about the team.
plays.opener: Thanks for having me. I'm really excited to be here.
